identity: Our method; never part of a paper baseline

features.columns: 4 logit(p),4 p-old_window_threshold,6 signed pairwise logit differences,6 equal old-threshold decisions,16 local probability max/mean (4 sources x radii1,3),4 source answermax probabilities
features.neighborhood: Symmetric clipped radius on each same-answer token_start-contiguous eligible-window chain. Break at missing starts; never bridge answers. Offline use of future neighbors is explicit.
features.identity: IDs locate boundaries/folds only, never numeric/text features. No gold, original text, label-derived boundaries, spans or risk types enter feature generation.

gates.keep: Only windows where frozen current >= its old window threshold. Target is original risk label.
gates.rescue: Only current-negative windows with at least one of semantic_claim/tail2/large >= its own old window threshold. Same original risk target.
gates.outside: Current-negative windows without any component alert stay negative.
gates.weights: Slice byte-bound original native group->answer->window base_weights by this gate and fold-fit indices. Compute class factors mass/(2*class_mass) using ONLY those labels; preserve this subset original base mass. No original binary loss reuse, second balancing, or postbalance group renormalization. Gate restriction changes group exposure.
gates.missing_class: Fail explicitly if a real fold/gate lacks either class; no constant model or changed structure fallback.

folds.rule: Sort615 fit group IDs; NumPy default_rng permutation; strided3 folds of205 groups. The same fold assignments apply to both gates and all answers/windows in a group.
folds.interpretation: Only the two gates are group-OOF. Frozen upstream fit scores and historical choices remain in-sample/cal-developed; this is not leakage-free end-to-end cross-fitting.

selection.rule: Use the two gate OOF probabilities on fit only. Joint unweighted whole-fit-window F1, then precision, then smaller L1 threshold distance to0.5. Stable enumeration breaks exact remaining ties. Identity is first with neutral distance0 and exact original current decisions.
selection.identity: No keep/rescue thresholds applied; preserve current window predictions exactly. This adds no learned fallback classifier.

training.order: Fit3 folds x2 gates and save all OOF scores/models/weights. Select and freeze thresholds on fit OOF. Then fit each gate on all its fit subset once; freeze both models before predicting/scoring cal.
training.all_fit_thresholds: Same OOF-selected thresholds apply to final fit and cal predictions; no final-fit threshold reselection.

output.window: Binary decision: keep/current-positive or rescue/eligible-negative threshold decisions. Gate probabilities separately saved; no fabricated unified calibrated window score.
output.answer: A separate unchanged head: retain exact original current answer_scores and its old answer threshold. It is intentionally NOT max over gated windows.
output.reporting: Whole fit OOF window metrics for threshold selection, final-model in-sample fit window metrics, and cal window metrics; answer metrics always original frozen current head. No window AUROC/AP invented from binary output.

limitations: Repeated calibration was used to develop/select the upstream models, current candidate and this hypothesis.
Group OOF at gate level cannot remove own-label exposure in the upstream fit scores.
The answer head and local decisions may disagree; this is one shared backbone with two output heads, not an all-window-max claim.
This is offline extra-semantic-model plus generator-signal decoding, not a pure generator probe or baseline modification.
